english: Group $P$ has $40$ observations with mean $50$ and variance $9$. Group $Q$ has $60$ observations with variance $16$, and the mean of $Q$ is greater than the mean of $P$. The variance of the $100$ observations of $P$ and $Q$ taken together is $19.2$. Then the mean of the observations of $Q$ is
hindi: समूह $P$ में $40$ प्रेक्षण हैं जिनका माध्य $50$ तथा प्रसरण $9$ है। समूह $Q$ में $60$ प्रेक्षण हैं जिनका प्रसरण $16$ है, तथा $Q$ का माध्य $P$ के माध्य से अधिक है। $P$ तथा $Q$ के सभी $100$ प्रेक्षणों को साथ लेने पर प्रसरण $19.2$ है। तब $Q$ के प्रेक्षणों का माध्य है
solution_full: Let $\bar x_Q=50+d$. The combined mean is $\bar x=\dfrac{40\cdot50+60(50+d)}{100}=50+0.6d$.
Deviations of the group means from $\bar x$: $d_P=-0.6d$, $d_Q=0.4d$.
Since the mean of $Q$ exceeds that of $P$, $d=5$ and $\bar x_Q=55$. (Without that condition, $45$ would also fit.)
originality_note: New: the combined variance is given and the unknown is a group mean, so the between-group term must be inverted, giving two symmetric values separated by an order condition (way 3: two conditions fix the object). Closest known: computing a combined variance from two groups. Different because: the formula is run backwards and the sign must be chosen.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Added the condition that Q's mean exceeds P's, so the answer is unique. Changed: added the order condition.
key_step: Inverting the combined-variance formula for the difference of means.
justification: A routine reverse use of one standard formula with a sign choice. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q12 (L2), which recovers observations from means and variances.

concept_use.Combined mean of two or more series: The combined mean 50 + 0.6d gives the deviations of the group means.
